author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: Cassette fixes. cassetteType no longer reports C5 on a C2: the model now comes only from fresh Total Alkalinity / Calcium Hardness / Cyanuric Acid readings (after swapping a C5 for a C2 it changes about 2 to 3 days after the last C5 sample). CassetteChecksLeft is sent as a number, so it is no longer re-sent on every poll. cassetteInfo no longer appends the raw N/M pads count, which duplicated CassetteChecksLeft. No attribute added, removed or renamed.
